why: A printing helper of Java that purity's list does not know: it lays a map literal out as Map.of(k, v, ...) up to the ten pairs Map.of takes and as Map.ofEntries(Map.entry(k, v), ...) past them (ts/src/helpers/opExample.ts javaMap). It reads no model and decides nothing shown; the old java components used the same helper (through javaMapOf).

Not in JAVA_CORE: JAVA_CORE is the constant 'core' (utility_java.ts, the subpackage Main_java's Folder writes). purity's fnBody looks for the first '{' after a const that is not an arrow function, so it reads the body of mavenGroupId, the next function in the file, as JAVA_CORE's. The line is mavenGroupId's own (the Maven group id, which the hook does not use).

The hook neither imports nor calls mavenGroupId: purity reached it through the misread body of the constant JAVA_CORE (see the entry above). It is Package_java's Maven group id (com.<org>), which no page prints.
